strips.title: Deal day in real life — how a calm shopper does Prime Big Deal Days

panels.head: Sept 30 — the list
panels.text: Write down what you actually need and the price that makes each one real. Twelve items, twelve numbers.

panels.head: Oct 6 — the 'was $1,600' trap
panels.text: A robot 'was $1,600, now $999'? It has been $900 all year. The only number that matters is yours.

panels.head: Oct 7, 7 AM — buy or skip
panels.text: Two items hit their price. Buy those. The rest stay on the list — Black Friday is seven weeks away.

panels.head: Oct 8 — done in ten minutes
panels.text: No cart full of 'deals'. Two real ones, money saved, and a list ready for November.
